mapper.sql: qual_id, type_id, qual_name, qual_level, creator, open_status
mapper.select: select from cbs.t_contractor_qual where type_id = #{typeId} and open_status = true order by create_time
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_contractor_qual (qual_id, type_id, qual_name, qual_level, creator, open_status) values (#{p.qual_id}, #{p.type_id}, #{p.qual_name}, #{p.qual_level}, #{p.creator}, #{p.open_status})
mapper.update: update cbs.t_contractor_qual set open_status = false where qual_id = #{id}
